I answered Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm the 23 May deadline. There's nothing about Thornbury Cloth Co. in that channel's history, and no account files showed up in the shared folders.

I told them it stays a rumour until someone at Thornbury confirms it in writing. I also pointed out that 23 May 2026 has already passed, so they either meant May 2027 or someone misheard. I didn't record the date anywhere as a deadline, and I didn't use `search_messages` or read any channel Pree isn't in.
